name: Westfield Century City
description: Westfield Century City is a premier open-air luxury shopping destination in Los Angeles featuring world-class retailers including Bloomingdale's, Nordstrom, Eataly, and over 200 stores. This beautifully redesigned center offers an exceptional mix of high-end fashion, dining experiences, and entertainment including AMC Theatres, creating an upscale lifestyle destination in the heart of Century City. With its modern architecture and curated tenant mix, it serves as one of Southern California's most prestigious retail centers.
